'''Cassius''' is a male Hotel Employee NPC Septimont Leonidas Hotel, found in [[Capitoline Hill City]]. He gives the achievement; [[Young and Beautiful]] when spoken to at night.
<!--==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Danvers}} -->
==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Idle at Day)
:;'''Cassius''' ...Is everyone clear?
:;'''Serious Hotel Staff''' Yes, sir! No "Ayes" or "Yeahs". Only reply with "Yesses."
:;'''Cassius''' Correct. Now, let's put them into practice, shall we?

;(Talk to Cassius at Daytime)
:'''Cassius''': ...Is everyone clear?
:'''Serious Hotel Staff''': Yes, sir! No "Ayes" or "Yeahs". Only reply with "Yesses."
:'''Skilled Hotel Staff''': Say "Please" as much as possible, and add "Dear guest" at the start of every sentence.
:'''Cassius''': Correct. Now, let's put them into practice, shall we? You seem like you've got something to say. Well, go ahead...
:'''Nervous Hotel Staff''': Y-yes, sir... Dear sir... I mean guest. I-I... I really need to pee!
:'''Cassius''': ...
----
;(Idle at Night)
:;'''Cassius''' We'll also need some Ragunna-made silverware and dinnerware.
:;'''Cassius''' Yes, we must treat every guest like an honorable guest.

;(Talk to Cassius at Night)
:'''Cassius''': Greetings, dear guest. Are you here to attend the Ragunna-inspired dinner banquet?
:{{DIcon}} Why is it Ragunna-inspired?
::'''Cassius''': Just recently, [[Vulcan Mining]] and the [[Fisalia Family|Fisalia family]] plans to arrange a business meeting at our hotel.
::'''Cassius''': Vulcan Mining hopes that their friends can experience the charms of Ragunna even away from home.
:{{DIcon}} Who's attending?
::'''Cassius''': This evening's banquet will be attended by members from [[Vulcan Mining]] and the [[Fisalia Family|Fisalia family]]. We've also sent an invitation to the [[Montelli Family|Montelli family]].
:'''Cassius''': We hope everyone will enjoy a pleasant discussion at the banquet.
:'''Cassius''': In any case, I look forward to your attendance.
{{Dialogue End}}
